name: 特德·霍夫
bio_short: 美国电子工程师，提出了微处理器的架构构想。当Busicom要求设计12个定制芯片时，他提出了革命性的反直觉方案：只设计一个通用的处理器，通过软件来定义功能，从而奠定了现代CPU的逻辑基础。
bio_short_en: American electrical engineer who formulated the architectural idea of the microprocessor. When Busicom requested 12 custom chips, he proposed a revolutionary counter-intuitive solution: build a single general-purpose processor driven by software, laying the logical foundation for modern CPUs.
